overview: Built an email routing workflow that identifies the assigned case manager and sends the case information to the appropriate person automatically.

list: Splits the incoming data into multiple paths
Checks conditions for the assigned case manager
Routes each case to the matching email address
Sends the appropriate email through Gmail
Returns the result back through the Sub Zap

blocks.p: The workflow includes separate routing paths for:
Each path contains its own condition and Gmail action, ensuring case information reaches the correct case manager without manual forwarding.

result: An automated case manager detection and email routing system that identifies the correct recipient, sends the case information to them, and handles cases where no case manager is assigned.
